shortDescription: The Baylor option in Polymarket’s “Texas Tech vs. Baylor” “Spread -20.5” market rose to 49.5% from 28% an hour earlier, a 21.5-percentage-point increase. According to ChainCatcher, the odds were monitored on the prediction market.
